_comment: Per-subject curation for the ETG (Elite Temple Guard) unit-analysis video. The METHOD lives in code; this file holds only the ETG-specific choices, applied by build_v2_categorization.py.
_remove_note: The generic Battle Elephant staple is modal-Bengalis; the video uses the BURMESE Elite Battle Elephant instead (see extra_results) — user choice 2026-07-19, the Howdah-armored variant (320 HP, 6/9 armor, vs Vietnamese's 420 HP); same 100F/70G cost, re-simmed fresh with the current frozen model.
_extra_results_note: These two were simmed separately (15 seeds, MAX_S=180) via a single-matchup V2 run rather than the batch. To re-sim them in the batch instead, move their keys into `add` and drop them here.
_ingame_note: EMPTY as of 2026-07-24 — there are no pins left for this subject; every matchup is the sim's own answer. The last two (White Feather Guard, Warrior Priest) retired when ENVELOP landed in sim_v2_model.js: melee contact capacity + overflow-to-the-flanks turned both from 75-88% sim WINS into native losses (0% and 13%), taking the recorded-tape suite 12/15 -> 14/15 with no regressions. Kept below for the audit trail. Earlier retirements: the Arambai pin 2026-07-19 when GRAZE_K made it a native loss at S -26, the War Elephant pin when TRAMPLE_K made it native S -33. HISTORY: White Feather Guard: V2 says +12/80% ETG win, but 5 in-game rolls (wfg_rolls/) were a 0/5 ETG LOSS (WFG keeps 8-14u / 25-38% HP, ~33s) — WFG has an unmodeled sustain mechanic (the extracted +0.5%/nearby Coiled Serpent HP aura, cap +15%, is far too small to explain it); NOT a CHURN artifact (wrong at 3.5=60% too). Warrior Priest (added 2026-07-19): V2 says 73% ETG with both armies shredded (9%/4% HP), but 2/2 in-game runs were decisive WP wins keeping ~15/21 units. CAUSE CONFIRMED 2026-07-24 — the single-column formation, NOT stats/abilities/healing. Scale test (sim: `_work/elite_temple_guard_muisca/run_wp_scaletest.js`; recordings: `~/Videos/aoe2_matchups/etg_wp_scaletest/`): at a fixed ~1.2:1 ratio the sim's ETG win-rate REVERSES with army size — 17v21 73%, 5v6 13%, 4v5 20%, 3v4 0% — because a long column only ever puts its front units in contact, so per-unit quality (the ETG's 2.0->1.0s reload ramp) decides instead of numbers. In game, 4v5 went WP 3/3 (1-2 of 5 alive), matching the sim's small-count read including the margin; 17v21 went WP (9 of 21 alive), contradicting it. So the combat model is CORRECT here and the column geometry throws the result away. Healing is a real but separate unmodeled effect (the Armenian UT Fereters doubles the WP's work rate = its heal rate, recorded in the audit trail only as an uninterpreted 'x2 attr_13') and is NOT needed to explain this matchup. Ground truth = loss; the pin retires when envelopment lands (2D formations in simulation_real -> bumps sim_version -> full re-sim). The same signature (ETG outnumbered + sim predicts an ETG win) very likely explains the White Feather Guard pin at 12v21/80%. (WFG note: its +0.5%/nearby HP aura IS modeled in simulate.js — the gap persists despite it.)
_exclude_note: Genitour is never shown in the video (not a useful/representative unit); it still appears in the full table.
